request.style: English, male baritone solo with full choir, harp, flute, strings, timpani, solemn and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Obil the Ishmaelite stands
Amidst the lists of David's hand
In charge of the camels he is known
A servant to the throne alone

[Verse]
He works beside Jehdeiah of Meronoth
Who watches over the she-donkeys
The fields and flocks are all managed
By men of wisdom and by angels

[Chorus]
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels
He holds the reins of David's wealth
A name recorded in the chronicles
In the service of the king's health

[Verse]
From storehouses in towns and villages
To herds that graze in Sharon land
The administration is complete
As the text of scripture plans

[Chorus]
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels
He holds the reins of David's wealth
A name recorded in the chronicles
In the service of the king's health

[Bridge]
Jaziz the Hagrite keeps the flocks
While Shitrai tends the Sharon hills
Together they manage the property
Of the king who the people fills

[Chorus]
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels
He holds the reins of David's wealth
A name recorded in the chronicles
In the service of the king's health

[Outro]
Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels
His duty in the record remains
